sources.title: Llama 3.1 8B: Open-weight LLM Overview
sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 8B is a decoder-only Transformer with 8B parameters and 32 layers, pre-trained on ∼1.4 trillion tokens for versatile NLP applications. It uses diff vector-based fine-tuning to transfer updates efficiently between model versions, yielding notable performance boosts like a +10.7% increase in GPQA accuracy. The model underpins domain-specialized variants in cybersecurity, astrophysics ...
